deals.evidence: Malkin and Jon Ledecky bought the Islanders in 2014 for $485 million
deals.headline: Malkin and Ledecky buy the Islanders for $485m
deals.summary: Scott Malkin and Jon Ledecky bought the Islanders in 2014 for $485 million (Forbes lists the purchase year as 2016, when they took majority control).

deals.evidence: Earlier that year, former NHL executive John Collins invested in the four-time Stanley Cup champions
deals.headline: Former NHL executive John Collins invests and takes charge of business operations
deals.summary: Earlier in 2023, former NHL executive John Collins invested in the Islanders and was put in charge of the team's business operations.

deals.evidence: In 2023, European private equity executive Oliver Haarmann bought a 10% stake in the Islanders at a $1.75 billion valuation.
deals.headline: Oliver Haarmann buys 10% of the Islanders at a $1.75bn valuation
deals.summary: European private equity executive Oliver Haarmann (a founding partner of Searchlight Capital) bought a 10% stake at a $1.75 billion valuation.

deals.evidence: David Shuman, founder of venture capital firm Lateralus Holdings, has reached a deal to invest in the New York Islanders
deals.headline: Venture investor David Shuman agrees to buy an LP stake in the Islanders
deals.summary: David Shuman, founder of venture capital firm Lateralus Holdings, reached a deal for a limited partnership stake; size and enterprise value not disclosed; subject to NHL approval.

deals.evidence: The New York Islanders reached an agreement to sell roughly 15% of the NHL franchise to a handful of investors at a $3 billion valuation
deals.headline: Islanders agree to sell roughly 15% at a $3bn valuation
deals.investor: A handful of investors incl. David Shuman (others not named)
deals.summary: The Islanders agreed to sell roughly 15% of the franchise at a $3 billion valuation to a handful of investors, one of whom would own up to 10%; BDT & MSD was retained to explore the sale; subject to NHL approval.
